close_reason: Added validate_id_field / validate_ids_field helpers using jmap_types::Id::new_validated for full RFC 8620 §1.2 syntax checking. Replaced 11 inline is_empty() guards in calendars-client (9 slice + 2 single-Id sites). Public API unchanged — still &str / &[&str]. Smoke tests continue to pass via substring assertions on key fields. Decision: Option A from the JMAP-231o.6 policy choice (full internal validation). Commits 00df1e3 + c266fb5 (latter for cleanup).
description:
Every method has `if id.is_empty() { return Err(InvalidArgument(...)) }` guards (calendar.rs:25, event.rs:27, event_copy.rs:22, event_notification.rs:22, event_parse.rs:24, participant_identity.rs:16, principal_availability.rs:22, etc).

Two issues:

1. The guards check ONLY emptiness. RFC 8620 §1.2 specifies Ids are non-empty strings of [A-Za-z0-9_-] up to 255 octets. The client accepts "\x00bad\n", " ", "#$%", arbitrarily long strings, etc — all will be sent to the server and rejected there with confusing error_type. The pre-flight guard exists to give a better error, but only catches one of the obvious cases.

2. `jmap_types::Id` already exists for this. Methods take `&[&str]` instead of `&[Id]` (or `impl IntoIterator<Item: AsRef<str>>`). Strongly typed Ids would let `Id::new_validated` enforce all of §1.2 at construction, eliminating this entire class of guard.

Lower priority because the server WILL reject invalid Ids — this is defense in depth, not soundness — but the current guards are a partial fix that signals 'we validate input' while letting most invalid input through. Either validate fully (call `Id::new_validated`) or remove the half-measure and document that callers are responsible.
notes: Closed 2026-05-09 with Option A (full internal validation, &str API kept). Option C (typed Id API) was the better engineering choice; deferred to JMAP-6by7 for the 0.2.0 cycle. The validate_id_field / validate_ids_field helpers and the 11 call sites added by this bead's commit are throwaway scaffolding that JMAP-6by7.1 will delete.
title: Empty-string guards reject server-legal Id (single space, etc) inconsistently
